subject: Re: Draw a line with intercept and slope on a ggvis plot

messages.author: 1161df5ae7a276da
messages.subject: Re: Draw a line with intercept and slope on a ggvis plot
parts:
Hi ggvis takes a dataframe as input so maybe something like the following would work:

library(ggvis)

x_min <- 2
x_max <- 5

m <- -1
b <- 2

x <- c(x_min, x_max)
y <- m*x + b

df <- data.frame(x = x, y = y)

df %>% ggvis(x = ~x, y = ~y) %>% layer_lines()


Another approach is to use layer_model_predictions:

df %>% ggvis(x = ~x, y = ~y) %>% layer_model_predictions(model = "lm", formula = y ~ x)

Also, there is an active google group on ggvis: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/ggvis

Hope this helps,

Ian
